specs.title: UX33-A2 aborted keeps one canonical original retry and never confuses an unknown outcome with an uncommitted one
UX33-A2 committed-reply-lost keeps one canonical original retry and never confuses an unknown outcome with an uncommitted one
UX33-A3 local objects point to one full recovery cause while viewing other playfields never replaces the failed source intent
UX33-A4 paid preparation failures retain actual limits without cross-gameplay wording or a fake zero-completion forecast
UX33-A5 a rejected source plan shows its actual reserve gate without a zero-yield plan and does not write anything
UX33-A6 reload and explicit takeover preserve the original remaining allowance without an offline reward or a duplicate clock
